tools.name: search_listings
tools.description: Search rooms, shared apartments, sublets and apartments for rent on Roomly, in New York City (Manhattan, Brooklyn, Queens, Bronx, Staten Island), New Haven, Israel and other cities. Use it when someone wants to rent a room, find a roommate, a sublet or an apartment. Every result has a url; give it t

tools.name: get_listing
tools.description: Full public details of one Roomly listing: price, dates, description, rooms, what is included, amenities and photos. Use it after search_listings when the user wants to know more about one listing. Pass the id or the url from search_listings. Returns the listing with its url, where the owner is cont

tools.name: list_locations
tools.description: Cities and areas with active Roomly listings, with how many each has. Use it when you are not sure Roomly covers a place, or to suggest where to look. Returns each location with its name (use it as search_listings location), country, listing count, search url and city page.

tools.name: rent_stats
tools.description: Typical asking rent in a city or area on Roomly, from live listings: the median and the usual range for a room, a whole apartment and a sublet, with how many listings it is based on. Use it when someone asks what rent costs or whether a price is fair. Returns monthly median, typical low and high, in

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "search_listings" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
